_: Per-project defaults for writ. Copy to .writ/config.json and edit.
Every key is optional, a command-line flag overrides anything here, and
whatever you leave out falls back to writ's own default. Writ never writes
this file: nothing will be reformatted or changed behind you.
This is a filled-in example, not the full schema — it sets the things a
project usually cares about. `writ init` generates a file holding every
field writ accepts at writ's own default, with a line explaining each one.
Any key starting with _ is a comment, since JSON has nowhere else to put one.
Unknown keys are refused rather than ignored — a misspelled 'reviewer' would
otherwise leave review running on the implementing model while this file
`writ agents` prints what your config currently resolves to.

agents._critic: defaults to the planning agent when not set
_stage: The three analyses — requirements, inventory, verification. Reading a
document and a repository is cheaper work than synthesising a plan from
them, so it is worth pointing somewhere cheaper. Unset: the planner.
agents._implementer: no timeout by default: the honest one depends on the task
_reviewer: Worth setting deliberately. Without it, review falls back to the
implementing agent, and a model checking its own work agrees with itself

run._: defaults for `writ run`, all overridable per invocation
_stream: Mirror each agent's own output to the terminal while it works, tagged
with the task and role it came from. On by default: a run that prints
nothing for the length of a model call looks identical to a hung one.
false keeps the progress log alone. The transcript is on disk either way.

_stages: The staged pipeline: three analyses write artifacts before a synthesis
agent decomposes the work from them. false is the older single-shot
planner, which makes all of those judgements in one response.
_critics: Run the critics over every plan straight after committing it. Costs an
agent run each, which is why writ does not do it unasked; this project
has decided it is worth it.

critique._: which critics run, here and for plan.critics. Unset means all of them.

_: the bounded repair loop that answers a plan's findings before it runs
(writ adjudicate). Two repairs may land; a finding still open after that
needs a decision rather than another patch.
_critics: re-run the critics after each patch, so a finding closes on a re-review
rather than on the patch's word. Costs a critic pass per round.

serve._host: loopback by default; the page has no authentication
